cover.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: Instagram carousel pickup guide cover, portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
Primary request: Design a polished, friendly cover for 128am Cafe's how-to-get-here guide. Use the supplied transparent mascot as a supporting compositing input. Preserve its girl, house, flowers, white sticker outline and rabbit with TWO fully visible ears.
Layout: pale warm cream #FFF8F5 background, subtle thin pink rounded border with generous 7% outer safe margin. Restrained blush #FDE5EB and sage #E7F0DC accents. Beautiful aligned grid, airy but intentional spacing. At top small dark cocoa brand name, below strong large rose rounded headline across two lines. Central mascot large enough to delight, approximately 45% width and fully contained. Below mascot a small sage pill with location. Bottom short cocoa save instruction and small Instagram handle. Keep all essential content inside central 85% of canvas. No photographs.
Typography: consistent bold friendly rounded Fredoka-like headline and highly legible Quicksand-like sans serif body. No cursive directions, outlined fonts, 3D lettering, gradients or shadows.
Exact text:
Top: "128am Cafe"
Headline: "How to find us"
Subheading: "Your pickup guide"
Location pill: "Junction 10 · The Tennery"
Bottom: "Save this for pickup day"
Footer: "@128am.cafe"
Color: headline deep rose #B8496C, body cocoa #4A3527, green #526F35. Overall professional minimal brand design, welcoming, clear hierarchy. No em dashes, no unit number, no QR code, no route map. Output one standalone finished cover, not mockup, no collage.

mrt.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: one Instagram pickup-directions carousel slide, portrait 3:4, matching the attached 128am Cafe cover.
Reference image 1: style reference for colors, friendly rounded typography and border only. Do not repeat its cover text or large central mascot.
Create a clean high-contrast direction card, with excellent mobile readability. Cream #FFF8F5 background, thin rounded pink border, deep rose #B8496C headings, cocoa #4A3527 body, pale sage #E7F0DC and blush #FDE5EB cards. Consistent Fredoka-like bold rounded heading and Quicksand-like readable body, no cursive and no outline lettering. Keep text safely inset 8% on all sides.
Layout: small top brand "128am Cafe", then small step capsule "STEP 01", large title "Coming by MRT?", then secondary line "Bukit Panjang MRT". Below place THREE separate generously spaced horizontal instruction panels stacked vertically. Each panel has a simple icon at left and the exact instruction at right in dark cocoa. The first panel pale sage, second white with pink border, third pale blush. Icons are simple generic rail exit, up escalator, walking figures respectively; these are pictograms not a physical route map. Connect panels subtly with short downward arrows to show sequence, never left/right road directions. Exact panel texts:
"Take Exit B"
"Go up the escalator"
"Cross the road towards
Junction 10 shopping mall"
Bottom small supporting line: "Next: look for The Tennery sign"
Footer: "@128am.cafe"
Keep spacious alignment, same font family for all instruction lines and obvious sequence. No unit number, no invented landmarks, no walking time, no street name, no location photo, no extra captions. No em dashes. Output one finished flat carousel image, no mockup, no collage.
